title: Profile Update: The Effects of Identity Disclosure on Network Connections and Language

bias_targets.methodology: Using difference-in-differences analysis to measure changes in offensive replies received after users disclose their age on Twitter profiles, and correlating age-specific language with algorithmic toxicity and offensiveness scores.

Measuring the volume of offensive replies targeted at users after disclosing specific ethnicities (e.g., African, Mexican, Indian) via profile updates, and analyzing how ethnicity-specific language is scored by automated offensiveness classifiers.

Evaluating targeted hostility by tracking offensive replies before and after users add gender pronouns (men, women, nonbinary) to their profiles, and calculating correlations between gender-specific language and toxicity/offensiveness scores.

Assessing changes in received offensive replies following the disclosure of political affiliations (e.g., liberal, conservative, activism) and evaluating the correlation of political-specific language with offensiveness classifiers.

Measuring the effect of disclosing religious identities (e.g., Islam, Hinduism, Christianity, Atheism) on the rate of offensive replies received, and examining algorithmic offensiveness scores applied to religion-specific language.

Analyzing the change in targeted offensive replies after users explicitly disclose LGBTQ+ identities on their profiles, and assessing the correlation between LGBTQ+-specific language and automated toxicity/offensiveness scores.
Using quasi-experimental methods (propensity score matching and difference-in-differences) to measure changes in offensive replies received before and after users disclose their occupations.
